thread:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — BrightLane reports missing audit entries for KeyCreate/Wrap after last infra patch. They say regulators are asking for proof of rotation + patch timeline. Need an ETA and mitigation plan. cc @incident-bot
Sophia Patel: got it. Can we get the customer's event IDs and exact API calls? ask them to share request_id + approximate timestamp
Alex Chen: pasted customer's excerpt: "RequestId: rl-9f2a3c, 2026-03-16T18:02:13Z — createKey returned 200 but audit entry absent in export"
Jamal Rivers: repro steps? we should try reproduce in staging, if it's a race with async audit flush
Kevin Ortiz: initial theory: audit service batching + new storage tiering caused lost events during compaction. Also possible keywrap library change dropped metadata fields tied to audit indexing — could be a CVE-related change in the crypto wrapper
Sophia Patel: asking infra for logs: @eng-infra can you grab audit-forwarder logs for node-gamma around 18:00Z and the wrap-service logs? include /var/log/redwood/audit/forwarder.log and /var/log/redwood/kms/wrap.log
Alex Chen: customer asking for patch ETA and whether key rewrap rotation is sufficient mitigation. They want a signed statement for their audit vendor by EOD
Jamal Rivers: mitigation plan proposal (short): 1) immediate: schedule on-demand export of raw writes for customer + snapshot of keystore 2) medium: force rewrap with new KMS master key (rotate KEK) 3) long: backfill audit index from raw writes and add checksum validation. I'll draft steps and ETA
Kevin Ortiz: rollback isn't great for hosted customers. Prefer "dual-write verification" and immediate KEK rotate for affected tenants. I'll prepare CLI to trigger per-tenant rewrap:
```
# trigger rewrap for tenant
redwood-cli kms rewrap --tenant brightlane --key-id abc123 --target-kek kek-2026-03
```
Sophia Patel: incident created INC-2105123 by @incident-bot: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2105123
Alex Chen: customer replied: "If you can't provide rotation proof within 6 hours we will escalate to compliance team." — pushing high priority
Jamal Rivers: I'll start reproduce in staging now and post logs. tagging @eng-ml for potential libcrypto trace
Kevin Ortiz: timeline estimate: hotfix + rewrap steps within 4-6 hours if no infra-side rollback needed. Backfill and audit proof could take 24-72 hours depending on export size
Sophia Patel: assigned to oncall: Jamal (SRE), Kevin (KMS), Alex (AM). Updating incident doc with steps and evidence checklist
Alex Chen: thanks. keep threads short and paste customer evidence in incident doc only, don't DM. :white_check_mark:
